name: passbolt-search
description: Search Passbolt entries and open connections from electerm

electerm.name: Passbolt Search
electerm.description: Search Passbolt resources by name, username, IP address, domain or URI. Your GPG key stays on this computer; passwords are decrypted locally and only when you open an entry.

configs.name: serverUrl
configs.label: Server URL
configs.description: Base URL of your Passbolt server.

configs.name: userId
configs.label: User ID
configs.description: Your Passbolt user UUID. In the web UI open Users / Manage Users & Groups, open your own user and copy the UUID from the page URL (/app/users/view/<UUID>).

configs.name: keyPath
configs.label: GPG key file
configs.description: Your exported OpenPGP private key (armored .asc or binary .gpg).

configs.name: passphrase
configs.label: Key passphrase
configs.description: Used only to unlock the key. It is never saved and never sent to the Passbolt server.

configs.name: query
configs.label: Search
configs.description: Name, username, IP address, domain or URI. Leave empty to connect only.
